`inter-regular.woff` is the Inter typeface (SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://openfontlicense.org),
used here only as a test fixture so satori has a real font to lay out text-bearing slide templates
with in `../../src/templates/*.test.ts`. It is not part of this package's published output.

Copied from Prisma Studio's bundled build assets (`prisma/build/public/assets/inter-all-400-normal.*.woff`)
since this environment had no outbound network access to fetch the font from Google Fonts directly.
